_about: Synthetic instruction files for the v2 split quality gate. Fictional people only. Each item is one memory a careful person would keep from the file, with the category they would pick. A candidate matches an item when, after normalizing whitespace, full/half-width punctuation, Markdown emphasis and trailing punctuation, one text contains the other. duplicates = lines that should be merged into an earlier identical line. Gate: category accuracy >= 80% over all items; manual work (missing items + wrong category + extra candidates + unmerged duplicates) <= 20% of items.
